            if (nx >= 1 && nx <= N && ny >= 1 && ny <= N && isdigit(grid_1[nx][ny]) && dist_map[nx][ny] == INF_DIST) {
                dist_map[nx][ny] = dist_map[x][y] + 1;

}

bool build_level() {
    static int level[MAXNODES];
    memset(level, 0, sizeof(level));
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(S);
    level[S] = 1;
    
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (auto& e : adj[u]) {
            if (!level[e.to] && e.cap > 0) {
                level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                q.push(e.to);
                if (e.to == T) return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

int dfs(int u, int flow) {
    if (u == T) return flow;
    for (auto& e : adj[u]) {
        if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[u] + 1) {
            int pushed = dfs(e.to, min(flow, e.cap));
            if (pushed) {
                e.cap -= pushed;
                adj[e.to][e.rev].cap += pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
